entries.appliesTo: public school employees and contractors performing services in a public school (definitional only)

sources.family: SEC. 1, Ed. Code § 98 — 'Both of the following mean a natural person: (a) A public school employee, including, but not limited to, certificated employees, classified employees, teachers, educators, short-term employees, principals, administrators, counselors, school nurses, school psychologists, and school social workers. (b) A contractor performing services in a public school.'

flags: Text contains no AI-specific language; the operative effect is definitional — restricting 'public school employee' and 'contractor performing services in a public school' to natural persons implicitly excludes non-natural persons (e.g., AI systems) from those roles, but the statute is silent on AI.
No duties, parameters, or penalty provisions in the enacted text; exposure omitted (silence is silence).
